FLAVOURTEXT.LOCALISED_TEXT: “As our numbers dwindle, the ranks of the dead grow ever stronger.” —Thalia, Knight-Cathar

“A medida que nuestro número mengua, las filas de los muertos no dejan de crecer”. —Thalia, caballero cátaro
„Je mehr sich unsere Reihen lichten, desto stärker werden die Reihen der Toten.“ —Thalia, Katharerritterin
“Mentre i nostri soccombono, le file dei morti diventano sempre più forti.” —Thalia, Cavaliera Catara
「我が方の数は減る一方なのに、死者の群れは増える一方ね。」 ――聖戦騎士、サリア
"우리 숫자가 줄면 죽은 자들의 숫자가 늘어난다." —카타르 기사 탈리아

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.INTERVENING_IF:
local numPlayers = MTG():GetNumberOfPlayers() for i = 0, (numPlayers-1) do local player = MTG():GetNthPlayer(i)
if player ~= nil and player ~= EffectController() then local interrogation = MTG():ClearInterrogationQuery() interrogation:SetPlayer( player ) local lifeLost = interrogation:Count( INTERROGATE_LIFE_LOST, INTERROGATE_PREVIOUS_TURN, 1 ) if lifeLost == 1 then return true end end end return false
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController() ) filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:AddCounters( MTG():PlusOnePlusOneCounters(), 1) end
